gray_compatibility.actual_reference: N07 ends Max at C0 on both real Choice presses because the active Java processor table can retain the last transformed channel independently of stored C0. Handler-before-paint, rendered state and complete tables remain in the pinned raw reference.
gray_compatibility.owned_policy: Use the same logical-state classification/final transformed-C0 rule as adopted native SelectMax. Native N07 first resolvesMin with transformed tables/C0; repeat resolvesMin without another transform. This explicit corrected behavior is deterministic across rendering, headless execution, replay and Save/Open.
gray_compatibility.reason: Current V2 display state records no Java processor cache or cache provenance. Equal serialized logical states can have different Java cached processors. Do not add unrecorded history, infer cache provenance from projection/C0, emulate paint artifacts or broaden the state schema solely to retain this cache quirk.
gray_compatibility.assertion_rule: Keep exact8 reference expectations including Java N07 Max/Max. Product tests independently assert the declared native N07 Min/Min and literal LUTs. Never claim exact N07 editor-transition parity. Independent policy review must finish before integration acceptance.
